overview_description.description: Quill Bills develops an AI-native platform for practice management and revenue cycle automation for healthcare providers. The company focuses on independent practices and clinics that need to streamline medical billing workflows across the full claim lifecycle. Its system connects to electronic health records to construct claims, auto-code encounters, verify eligibility, scrub claims against payer rules, and submit clean claims. Quill Bills also automates rejection and denial follow-up, claim status monitoring, and payment posting from remittances. In addition, it supports patient billing with digital statements, payment links, and installment tracking. The platform combines rule-based processing with AI agents, including automated phone calls to insurance payers, to reduce manual work in billing operations.
